name: Tech Text
description: Large canvas-drawn word with a technical blueprint feel. Hovering letters reveals dashed outlines, selection frames, metric labels and moving specks, and letters can be dragged and flicked with spring physics.
contents: Single canvas that draws the text as glyph sprites
Typographic metric lines (baseline, x-height, cap height, ascender, descender) with labels
Per-letter selection frame and orbiting specks
behavior: Letters outline with dashes near the pointer, either per hovered letter or across an area of reach
Idle sweep moves the highlight along the text automatically when the pointer is away
Letters can be dragged and spring back with adjustable bounce
Clicking a letter gives it a kick impulse
Optional intro animation: type, assemble or metrics
Renders only while visible and adapts to resize, font loading and light or dark theme changes
Intro and idle sweep are skipped when reduced motion is preferred
editableByProps: Text, font family, weight, size, letter spacing and alignment
Outline dash look, stroke width, reveal mode and reach
Toggles for specks, selection frame, labels, guides, dragging, click kick and idle sweep
Bounce, speed and intro animation type and duration

needsCodeEdit.change: Change how much of the container the word may fill
needsCodeEdit.where: fit calculation (0.9 and 0.66 factors) in ensureLayout

fixed: Must be placed in a parent with a defined height, since the root is w-full h-full
Word is auto-shrunk to fit 90% of width and 66% of height, fontSize acts as a maximum
Text is a single line, no wrapping
Settings changes are applied through a ref, not by recreating the canvas
Root uses touch-pan-y and select-none, with role img and aria-label from text
Sets the container cursor style (grab, grabbing, pointer) while interacting
Observes document theme attributes and color scheme changes to repaint
Pointer driven, so hover reveal has no equivalent on touch screens, only tap and drag
